---
name: design-change-request
description: Propose a controlled change to an approved ClipYantra screen, token, component, navigation or interaction pattern.
---

# Design Change Request

Do not immediately alter approved design. First explain: current approved state, problem evidence, user impact, proposed change, alternatives, affected screens/components/tokens, accessibility/responsive impacts, test requirements and migration risk. Create an ADR/design change proposal if authorized. Request explicit `APPROVE DESIGN CHANGE <ID>` before implementation.
